'''''Whispermoon''''' is the debut studio album by [[Listener (musician)|Listener]].  It was released on [[Mush Records]] on July 29, 2003.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mushrecords.com/release/MH217.php|title=MH-217: Listener - Whispermoon|work=[[Mush Records]]|access-date=May 26, 2017}}</ref> It peaked at number 163 on the [[CMJ]] Radio 200 chart<ref>{{cite journal|title=CMJ Radio 200 (Period Ending 8/26/2003)|journal=[[CMJ New Music Report]]|date=September 8, 2003|page=11}}</ref> and at number 4 on CMJ's Hip-Hop chart.<ref>{{cite journal|title=Hip-Hop (Period Ending 8/26/2003)|journal=[[CMJ New Music Report]]|date=September 8, 2003|page=18}}</ref>

==Critical reception==
Jason MacNeil of [[AllMusic]] gave the album 3 stars out of 5, saying, "Not as polished or glossy as bigger rap stars, this record has a certain independent aura around it."<ref name=allmusic/> Rollie Pemberton of ''[[Pitchfork (website)|Pitchfork]]'' gave the album a 6.6 out of 10 and said, "The saving grace of ''Whispermoon'' is its varied production."<ref name=pitchfork/>
